description.value: Founded in 1998, New Amsterdam Cafe bills itself as North America's first 420-friendly cafe and one of the oldest cannabis companies in the world, operating as an inclusive cannabis-inspired lounge in Vancouver's Gastown neighbourhood. The venue combines a relaxed lounge atmosphere with food, drinks, catering, and event bookings, and hosts the annual Cannabis Hospitality Summit. Patrons must be 19 or older to enter.
